tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_chaos_knight_chaos_: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
Even Chaos Knight cannot predict this manifest of unholy energy.
The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.
Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals %illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%% less damage.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight_bio:
The veteran of countless battles on a thousand worlds, Chaos Knight hails from a far upstream plane where the fundamental laws of the universe have found sentient expression. Of all the ancient Fundamentals, he is the oldest and most tireless, endlessly searching out a being he knows only as "The Light." Long ago the Light ventured out from the progenitor realm, in defiance of the first covenant. Now Chaos Knight shifts from plane to plane, always on the hunt to extinguish the Light wherever he finds it. A thousand times he has snuffed out the source, and always he slides into another plane to continue his search anew.

Upon his steed Armageddon he rides, wading into battle with maniacal frenzy, drawing strength from the disorder of the universe. A physical manifestation of chaos itself, in times of need he calls upon other versions of himself from other planes, and together these dark horsemen ride into battle, as unstoppable as any force of nature. Only when the last Light of the world is scoured from existence will the search be ended. Where rides the Chaos Knight, death soon follows.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight_hype: Chaos Knight is an army unto himself. Able to summon a cavalry of clones to demolish enemy defenses, should an enemy present itself, he can rift reality to pull him and his phantasms close enough to rain brutal cudgel blows upon their head.

mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Teleport}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} + {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*#* Has the following [[teleport]] properties:
*#** Neither {{M|disjoints}} incoming {{M|projectiles}} for Chaos Knight nor for the affected enemy.
*#** The final teleport location for both Chaos Knight and the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy is determined upon the ability's {{M|cast point}}.
*#** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*#*** Has an ability visual effect indicator.
*#* [[File:Dota2 Chaos Knight Reality Rift User-1 icon.png|105px|Chaos Knight's teleportation visualized.]][[File:Dota2 Chaos Knight Reality Rift User-2 icon.png|105px|Chaos Knight's teleportation visualized.]]
*#** Teleports Chaos Knight in a straight line, to a point within line [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] , {{#var:Reality Rift value1}} ({{Symbol|bonus t1l}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Reality Rift value1 tal}}|10tal}})-distance from the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy's current position, towards the original ability cast location.
*#* [[File:Dota2 Chaos Knight Reality Rift Enemy-1 icon.png|105px|The affected enemy's teleportation visualized.]][[File:Dota2 Chaos Knight Reality Rift Enemy-2 icon.png|105px|The affected enemy's teleportation visualized.]]
*#** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|l}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*#*** Teleports the affected enemy unit {{Code|{{#expr:{{#vardefineecho:Reality Rift colsize|({{Show|H|Chaos Knight|collisionsize}}+{{G|collision size hero}}+8)}}}}-distance}} in front of Chaos Knight, this is defined as:
*#**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|EnemyDistance {{=}} Caster[[Collision Size|ColSize]] + EnemyColSize + 8}}
*#**** Hence, for most enemy heroes, it effectively teleports the affected unit {{calc|v1-{{#var:Reality Rift colsize}}|v1={{#var:Reality Rift value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t1l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1-{{#var:Reality Rift colsize}}|v1={{#var:Reality Rift value1 tal}}}}|10tal}}) distance.
*#*** Does not interrupt the affected enemy unit's {{M|channeling}} abilities.
*# {{hi|Chaos Knight}} {{Symbol|Illusions}}
*#* All Chaos Knight's illusions are teleported from random angles within the search radius, and surround the affected enemy unit equal to the same distance of Chaos Knight to the affected enemy unit.
*#* The ability issues an attack order to all Chaos Knight-based illusions on the affected enemy unit upon teleport completion.
*#* Affects the following illusion sources:
*#** {{A|Chaos Knight|Phantasm}}-based.
*#** Items and {{M|Illusion Rune}}-based.
*#** Illusions sourced from ally's abilities.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|chaos_knight_reality_rift_debuff}}
*#* Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.

* {{cf|talnotes}} {{Symbol|bonus t3l}} Now affects {{M|Couriers}}.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# The {{#var:Phantasm value1}}-second {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|chaos_knight_phantasm}} split time.
*#* Applies the following ability effects:
*#** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
*#*** Grants a {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 400-radius [[flying vision]] centered around Chaos Knight.
*#** {{M|Hidden}}
*#*** This ability component {{M|disjoints}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.
*#** {{M|Invulnerable}}
*#** {{M|Stun}}
*#** {{M|Unselectable}}
*# {{Symbol|Stop}}
*#* Issues Chaos Knight a [[stop command]], canceling all queued orders, including orders to {{M|summons|text=player-controlled units}}.
*#* Applies a {{M|basic dispel}}.
*# Creates the {{Symbol|Phantasm}} {{M|illusions}} based on the ability's cast position, with the following formation properties:
*#* The formation corresponds to the ability's cast position and number of illusions.
*#* Chaos Knight and his illusions' reappear in random positions within fixed formations, {{M|facing angle|text=facing}} the same direction as follows:
*#** With 3 illusions: {{Symbol|Illusform|3a}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|3b1}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|3b2}}
*#** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} With {{ValueColor||4|agh}} illusions: {{Symbol|Illusform|4a}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|4b1}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|4b2}}
*#* With three or more illusions, two random illusions may be created at the same coordinates, one of which will be pushed {{G|clear space distance}}-distance away.
*#* {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
*#** With {{ValueColor||1|agh}} illusions: {{Symbol|Illusform|1}}
*#** With {{ValueColor||2|agh}} illusions: {{Symbol|Illusform|2a}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|2b}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|2c}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|2d}}
*#* The illusion bounty is defined as:
*#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|{{G|illusion bounty level factor}} × [[Illusion#Bounty|Illusion]]<sub>LVL</sub>}}

* Recasting the ability replaces all Phantasm-based illusions from the current instance and adapts the ability values accordingly, regardless of whose control they are under, except for the following situations:
** An {{A|Enchantress|Enchant|text=Enchanted}} {{M|illusion|x}}.
** When affected by the following sources:
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.
*** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} has two components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** Creates {{Code|{{ValueColor||1|agh|x}} or {{ValueColor||2|agh|x}}}} {{Symbol|Phantasm}} Phantasm-based {{M|illusion}} per allied hero {{M|Global|text=globally}} under Chaos Knight's control.
**** This ability component considers {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
*** Applies only the {{M|basic dispel}} on affected allied heroes.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
**** Does not apply the split time ability component to all affected allied heroes.
**** Does not affect the following allied heroes:
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*** Adds a passive component to Phantasm.
**** The ability proc is determined during upon casting Chaos Knight's {{M|illusion}}-creating source and uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Procagh|{{#var:Phantasm type3 value1 agh}}}}.
*** {{Symbol|Illusions}}
**** Both offensive and defensive [[illusion]]-creating sources now create {{#var:Reins of Chaos value2}} additional Chaos Knight-based illusion upon proc, following the illusion source's base illusion stats.
**** The following stats are applied to the additional created illusion:
***** Illusion type (e.g. {{M|Strong Illusion}}).
***** Both the {{M|incoming damage}} and the {{M|outgoing damage}} values.
***** Duration.
***** The illusion's bounty corresponds to the illusion-creating source.
**** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
***** The additional illusion created does not follow the illusion source's hue.
*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}}
**** Other ability-based bonuses granted through buff application on the created illusion is not copied.

abilities: Phantasm spawns real illusions that pile damage after a Chaos Bolt stun.

Mjollnir / Maelstrom's chain lightning clears Chaos Knight's illusions.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Chaos Knight's targeted disable.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_chaos_knight
data.bio_loc:
The veteran of countless battles on a thousand worlds, Chaos Knight hails from a far upstream plane where the fundamental laws of the universe have found sentient expression. Of all the ancient Fundamentals, he is the oldest and most tireless, endlessly searching out a being he knows only as "The Light." Long ago the Light ventured out from the progenitor realm, in defiance of the first covenant. Now Chaos Knight shifts from plane to plane, always on the hunt to extinguish the Light wherever he finds it. A thousand times he has snuffed out the source, and always he slides into another plane to continue his search anew.

Upon his steed Armageddon he rides, wading into battle with maniacal frenzy, drawing strength from the disorder of the universe. A physical manifestation of chaos itself, in times of need he calls upon other versions of himself from other planes, and together these dark horsemen ride into battle, as unstoppable as any force of nature. Only when the last Light of the world is scoured from existence will the search be ended. Where rides the Chaos Knight, death soon follows.
data.hype_loc: Chaos Knight is an army unto himself. Able to summon a cavalry of clones to demolish enemy defenses, should an enemy present itself, he can rift reality to pull him and his phantasms close enough to rain brutal cudgel blows upon their head.
data.npe_desc_loc: Has strong but random damage output

abilities.name: chaos_knight_chaos_bolt
abilities.desc_loc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
abilities.lore_loc: Even Chaos Knight cannot predict this manifest of unholy energy.
notes_loc: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.
abilities.shard_loc: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals %illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%% less damage.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_reality_rift
abilities.desc_loc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
abilities.lore_loc: Armageddon rides between the planes, bringing Chaos Knight to his victim wherever he may hide.
notes_loc: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.
abilities.shard_loc: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.
facets_loc: Reality Rift has equal chances of applying Break, Disarm, or Silence for %additional_debuff_duration_percent%%% of the base debuff duration in addition to its normal effects.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_chaos_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
abilities.lore_loc: Chaos Knight's unwieldy power bludgeons those who stand before him, crushing the thickest of armors.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_fundamental_forging
abilities.desc_loc: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
notes_loc: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_phantasm
abilities.desc_loc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: Drawing on his battles fought across many worlds and many times, phantasms of the Chaos Knight rise up to quell all who oppose him.
notes_loc: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
abilities.scepter_loc:
Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
